_comment: Plain-language words. Shown as tap-to-explain chips wherever the word appears. Keep each explanation to one or two short sentences a 9-year-old can read. Portions generated with the assistance of an SI tool (Claude) and reviewed by Team PlutonyX.

terms.say: A day on Mars. It is about 40 minutes longer than a day on Earth.
Tiny, fast particles and rays from the Sun and from deep space. You cannot see or feel them. Too many over a lifetime are bad for the body.
How much radiation a body has soaked up. It only ever adds up, like steps on a step counter.
A tiny unit for measuring radiation dose. Scientists write it µGy.
A giant flash of light and X-rays on the Sun. The classes go C, M, X. X is the strongest.
Short for coronal mass ejection. A huge cloud of hot gas thrown out by the Sun. It can cross the solar system in a few days.
Very fast particles shot out by the biggest eruptions. They can reach Mars in less than an hour.
Glowing light in the sky made when particles from the Sun hit the air. Earth has them near the poles. Mars can have them all over.
An invisible shield around Earth that pushes solar particles away. Mars lost its own long ago.
Radio travels at the speed of light, and Mars is far away. A message needs many minutes to cross.
A fan of mud and sand that a river leaves where it flows into a lake or sea.
The loose dust and broken rock that covers the ground on Mars and the Moon.
A clue that living things may once have been there. A clue is not proof.
A stick of rock, about the size of a piece of chalk, drilled out and sealed in a tube.
A machine that takes the gas we breathe out (carbon dioxide) out of the air.
A number for how much dust is in the sky. Bigger means darker. 1 is a normal dusty day. Over 10 is almost night.
A best guess about what will happen, made by a computer model. It can be wrong.
Extra that you keep just in case: spare power, spare air, spare time.
The short time when the planets are lined up so a ship can make the trip.
Our game's unit of electricity. One cell runs one machine on Low for one sol.
